verdict.rationale: Orrick's Patents practice page is a documented group page. It states that its PTO-registered lawyers regularly help clients secure new patent rights, which covers the core of the prosecution story. A Tech Studio stage page on creating and protecting what differentiates your company adds some support. Missing for 10: explicit portfolio-strategy or defensible-position offering, named patent prosecution practitioners, detail on application drafting and filing beyond one sentence (the page leans toward litigation and IPR), and independent corroboration.
